task_description: Audit + bug-fix + security hardening + modern GUI redesign + new features for Flatpak Batch Installer v0.6.1
project_type: Python 3.10+ desktop GUI app — Tkinter + ttkbootstrap, with a CLI mode
build_system: setuptools (pyproject.toml); no compile step — Python source only. `python3 -m compileall -q flatpak_batch_installer flatpak-gui.py tests` confirms syntax.
test_framework: stdlib unittest; test discovery via `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`. GUI tests skip automatically when Tk raises TclError (no display).
verification_instructions: 1. Run `python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v` from the repo root. All tests must pass (SkipTest acceptable for GUI tests with no display). 2. If a display is available: `xvfb-run -a python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v`. 3. Syntax check: `python3 -m compileall -q flatpak_batch_installer`.
snapshot_or_generated_files: assets/hicolor/**/*.png and flatpak_batch_installer/data/icon.png are generated by `python3 assets/make_assets.py`. Do NOT regenerate during code tasks.
environment_constraints: Never add pip dependencies beyond ttkbootstrap. Never call tkinter in catalog.py or flatpak.py. ttkbootstrap.Style is a process-wide singleton — tests share one FlathubBrowser instance (see BrowserTest.setUpClass). Absolute worktree path: /home/elshad-guliyev/Documents/flatpak-batch-installer — always use this when navigating, never rely on relative paths.
contribution_requirements: From AGENT.md: GUI never freezes (Flatpak calls in background threads); explicit --user/--system on every flatpak call; catalog.py/flatpak.py must be GUI-free and headless-testable; theme.py must work with and without ttkbootstrap; GUI tests must SkipTest when tk.Tk() raises TclError; no destructive commands without user confirmation; update README.md + CHANGELOG.md for user-facing changes.
key_patterns: Background threads post results via queue.Queue (self.log_queue) polled every 100ms by poll_log(); GUI updates scheduled with self.after(0, callback). All subprocess calls use list-of-args via run_flatpak() or stream_command() — never shell=True or string interpolation. scope_args(scope) returns ['--user'] or ['--system']. Treeview rows tagged 'even'/'odd' for stripes. Dialogs are singletons in self._dialogs dict keyed by string. _build_widgets() lays out the GUI; _init_theme() wires up theme; _build_shortcuts() wires key bindings.
directory_structure: flatpak_batch_installer/ — main package (ui.py is the only tkinter-importing module); tests/ — unittest suite; assets/ — icon source + generated PNGs (do not edit); packaging/ — .desktop, metainfo, AppImage, .deb build scripts; docs/ — distribution guide; flatpak-gui.py — thin launcher (main entry point); flathub-gui.py — deprecated alias.
